findings.excerpt: private theorem main (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (data : ModularPolynomialData N) (i : ℕ) :
findings.problem: The whole `DegBound` namespace (about 200 lines) re-proves the degree bound `(data.Φ.coeff i).natDegree ≤ N * (dedekindPsi N - i)`. This bound is already a named theorem in `Theorems/`. The same proof also exists in `Sol/S_ModularCurve_ModularPolynomialData_natDegree_coeff_le_level_mul_dedekindPsi_sub.lean` and in a second Sol file. The repeated pieces are the `Good` valuation-lower-bound predicate, the sum, product and `X - C r` lemmas, the `qExpand` order lemma, and the slot/Galois-conjugate bound. The only caller, `exists_honest`, uses `main` solely as `(fun i => DegBound.main N data i)`. That is the statement of the existing theorem.
findings.proposed_change: Add `import Theorems.Thm_ModularCurve_ModularPolynomialData_natDegree_coeff_le_level_mul_dedekindPsi_sub` to the imports. Delete `namespace DegBound … end DegBound` (lines 42–248). In `exists_honest`, replace `(fun i => DegBound.main N data i)` with `(fun i => ModularCurve.ModularPolynomialData.natDegree_coeff_le_level_mul_dedekindPsi_sub N data i)`. The statement is `∀ (N) [NeZero N] (data : ModularPolynomialData N) (i : ℕ), (data.Φ.coeff i).natDegree ≤ N * (dedekindPsi N - i)`, which has exactly the hypotheses `exists_honest` supplies. The proof sketch stays that of the existing theorem: `Φ.coeff i` is a polynomial in `j`; the Galois-conjugate slots give a product of `X - C (slot)`; each slot has order at least `-N²`; the coefficient has order at most `-N·deg`; compare. If any of the `Good`/`le_orderTop_sum`/`le_orderTop_qExpand` lemmas are wanted elsewhere, they should live in one shared place, not be copied per file.
findings.benefit: This removes about 200 lines of duplicated proof from this file. The degree bound then has one proof to maintain, not three or more. A reader no longer has to check that the private copy matches the library theorem. The pattern is already used by another Sol file that imports the theorem.
